nodes.question: What measures can be taken to mitigate the financial and environmental impact of these climate disasters in the future?
nodes.answer: Measures to mitigate the financial and environmental impact of these climate disasters in the future include investing in resilient infrastructure, implementing early warning systems, promoting sustainable land management practices, enhancing disaster preparedness and response mechanisms, and adopting climate adaptation strategies at local, national, and international levels.
